{{Quote|I will take Dubrava! Anything will be better than being forced to see your stupid looks one more time.| [[Jal Te Gniev]]|<ref name="Vader's Quest 1">[[Vader's Quest 1|''Vader's Quest'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Dubrava''' was a planet where [[Jal Te Gniev]] was placed to recruit [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol discovered him, by an accident, in a local [[Unidentified bar (Dubrava)|cantina]] where they had tracked down a female informant. Jal's life was saved by the young [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Dubravan]], [[Bobek]]. The planet was referred to as the galaxy's armpit hole.
